method: Read governing method, required inputs, output contract, boundaries, references and limitations in actual local SKILL.md files. Example data/code and legal/financial statements were not independently validated or executed. Review is applicability and preparation safety, not execution or professional signoff.

records.applicability: GL/subledger/bank reconciliation methods match expense-register reconciliation. Preserve period, opening/closing balances, reconciling categories and qualified reviewer signoff; no journal posting.

Revenue/cost drivers, cash timing, scenarios and variance are explicit methods. Recipe selects cash timing/scenario work, with source opening cash and dated flows; no invented confidence bands or historical actuals.
Decomposition, materiality and a reconciled bridge support budget-overrun explanations. Show any residual; source numerical thresholds and illustrative examples do not become owner rules.

Control mapping, status/evidence gaps and remediation match preparation. Use owner/reviewer supplied scope and current dated primary requirements; source industry shortcuts do not establish legal applicability or certification.

Requirements, scope/value/dates and proposal/SOW templates support website project quotations. Output is a review draft; source template percentages, legal generalizations and jurisdictions are not automatically applicable.

Party perspective, operative terms, clause risks and alternative wording fit amendment/renewal/proposal review. Proposed clauses stay proposed and current jurisdictional meaning requires appropriate review.
Requires an existing ordered checklist with pass/stop rules and must not invent one. Purchase and sponsorship intakes now explicitly require that checklist.
Historical spending, phased budget, actual variance and adjustments fit department planning. Cash-buffer use is restricted to budget response options tied to the preceding reconciled cash scenarios.
PaperJSX is generation-only from JSON schema, not a document editor or renderer. Recipe creates a new Word file, then uses an actual converter and PDF renderer for separate verification.

Narrative choice, source IDs, explicit layout, native objects and manual/render QA match editable briefing deck creation. Require user-approved custom outline, approved build environment and real renderer; absent renderer leaves visual QA pending.
HR employee-data minimization, consent/access and AI processing review match the HR access-change preparation. Missing local policy/jurisdiction remains a question and no access is changed.

Extracts sourced commitments with stable IDs, owner/date/status gaps and proposed writes. Invoice/payroll/compliance results are supplied as source evidence; discussion is not accepted ownership or completion.
Turns verified figures into plain comparisons while retaining the actual amount. Spreadsheet handoff provides units/periods and forbids adding unsupported equivalences.
Full invoice processing covers extraction, PO/receipt matches, flags and batch summary. Source GL examples and default tolerances do not replace user approval rules; never release payment.
Exact recomputation script or shown arithmetic, common fields and date/currency/rounding checks match independent invoice arithmetic. Determines no applicable tax treatment.
Writer format conversion explicitly supports DOCX/ODT/PDF through soffice. Recipe converts the actual generated Word document into a separate review PDF and preserves the native source.

Period/roster/intake/hour totals/anomaly review support payroll input checking via uploaded records. Recipe restricts use to read-only review, needs confirmed rates/rules/prior totals and stops before flag edits, staging or journals.
Page rendering and visible inspection match both scanned-fact verification and actual Word-to-PDF review. Tool presence and reviewed pages must be recorded; no text-only layout claims.
HR risk identification, assessment, mitigation and owner review fit employee data/access risks. No private trait inference or unapproved employee decision.

Income, essentials, discretionary spending and savings plan establish purchase affordability. Owner commitments and chosen limits take precedence over source default percentages; no transfer is executed.
Supported draft editing preserves meaning, uncertainty and facts. It is not a source of new controls, evidence or legal interpretation.

Portable original prompt needs full contract and party perspective, returns duties, money/dates, exit and source sections. Replaces private lawyer-plugin summary/config assumptions; proposed/base versions stay distinct.
Audience/purpose/narrative/outline/notes methods support report-to-briefing planning. Recipe uses outline mode before the separate native PPTX build and preserves source qualifications.
Grammar/consistency/style correction supports final text checking only within assessable language scope. It does not prove translations, facts or source consent.

LiteParse offers spatial text, OCR and page screenshots with page/error coverage checks. Recipe requires local OCR/language data and compares important values to visible source pages; extraction confidence is not proof.

Procurement normalization, supplier/category/usage analysis and consolidation options support subscription reviews. Actual usage and contract scope are required; missing usage is not unused and sample savings percentages are not evidence.

Full source covers inventory/grain, normalization, formula validation, reconciliation, auditable output, re-open and render. Its general method replaces India-only formula audit and tax-default category methods; preserve raw data and label unavailable recalculation.
Audience/cadence/source progress and decision updates match variance briefs. Proposed options are distinguished from approved budget changes.

Actual method compares physical-product MOQ, unit costs, lead time, retail margin, cash, terms and quality checks. Intake now includes planned retail price and stock cash limit; no deposit or inspection purchase is executed.

Risk identification, criticality, evidence and mitigation fit the supplied supplier-risk evidence stage. Recipe limits it to sourced evidence and forbids treating illustrative weights, buffer months or cost-reduction factors as facts.

Agreement identity/status/term/renewal/notice and unavailable-source coverage support subscription renewal decisions. Uploaded actual agreements remain the evidence and no unsearched system is claimed checked.
TCO, implementation/training/exit costs, risk/performance and side-by-side options match supplier/service purchase comparisons and renewal briefs. Unsupported quality or savings remains unknown.

Six phases define concept, UX, design, architecture, accessibility and MVP scope. Intake is explicitly a website project, not arbitrary freelance services; estimate/contract assumptions remain separate from approved scope.
